headline: Can an AI Agent Complete Paid Software Work? Evidence from $1 Million in Real Freelance Tasks
reviewer: AI editorial simulation (not a human reader test)
summary: SWE-Lancer tested AI agents on 1,488 real software tasks worth $1 million in historical payouts; original leading models completed meaningful work but still failed most tasks.
decision: BLOCKED pending exact-article mobile Chromium, actual bilingual TTS, and exact-head live verification
language_evidence: Original editorial English passed the 20–30 second simulation and preserves all evidence boundaries.
